notes: Canonical per-file CHECKSUM manifest for a Track-2 unit (validated by qfbench2_common.manifest.verify_manifest). One entry per committed file: path is relative to the unit dir; sha256 is the lowercase hex digest; role is one of input/reference/fixture/scenario/corpus/trace; split is public-dev/validation/private-test. The forecasting data-spec (panels/targets/scoring) lives in forecast_spec.json, NOT here. Replace all TEMPLATE_ placeholders and one entry per real file. license and source are RIGHTS DETERMINATIONS, not boilerplate: use MIT for organizer-authored files, LicenseRef-US-Gov-Public-Domain for U.S. federal works, LicenseRef-Source-Terms for third-party material whose issuing institution's terms govern, and LicenseRef-Unverified where the rights basis is not established. Do NOT default to CC-BY-4.0 — it was never granted for any third-party document in this repository. redistributable is a PUBLICATION GATE, not a rights summary: false means the file must NOT ship in a public unit (it is then referenced by checksum only and may be absent on disk), and the public-safety check fails any public unit that references one. This template ships false so a new unit fails closed; set it true for each file you are actually publishing. See DATA-LICENSE.md.
